== Published English Original Virtual Set 9 wording ==
The original and later Corellia Objective are separate from the Decipher Tatooine Objective. The later faces change the starting setup, restrictions and flip test on the front, and replace the battle and card exchange abilities with their printed Corellia effects on the reverse.
